values.keys: canonical English JSON keys; canonical fictional names from aliases; evidence quotes remain verbatim in delivered language
values.normalization: NFKC; collapse whitespace and trim for names and scalar textual values only. Exact citation quotes are never normalized by the submitter.
values.routes: Literal normalized identifiers; no route alias is declared. Never infer route names from subjects.
values.quantity: Exact decimal rational multiplied by the declared unit ratio; no floating-point rounding, fuzzy correction or missing-value completion.
values.duplicates: Collapse extensionally identical assertions and equivalent duplicates; retain contradictory extras as errors.
values.supplied_null: Extraction null means not supplied; never deletion, false, zero or inheritance.
values.slot_state_rule: Only value has non-null content; not_specified asserts that the decision specifies no value, distinct from missing evidence.

scope.equality: Expand any/all partitions to the 12 Cartesian cells; compare extensionally.
scope.interval: Source-claimed [from,to), not a query-time slice; null endpoint is unbounded. Bare dates start at local midnight; through a date ends at next local midnight.
scope.expiry: No successor or fallback to an older decision; last-known values belong to requested expired history.

updates.correction: The predecessor assertion was erroneous and never adopted; replacement is adopted.
updates.reversal: Withdraw the whole predecessor and its fields, then adopt the replacement.
updates.complete_replacement: Clear all selected predecessor fields before installing supplied assignments.
updates.commitment: Proposed, rejected and quoted suggestions are not adopted decisions; never confuse rejection of the predecessor with rejection of the replacement.

citations.aliases: Resolve only legitimate delivered sameAs/sameAsBody aliases. Never substitute a different unit, source or occurrence.
citations.normalization: Use exactly the delivered body/excerpt, after any delivery normalization. A raw-source spelling absent from delivery cannot anchor a citation.
citations.truncation: Cite only the delivered substring; omitted text and its provenance are not evidence.
citations.overlap: Count exact matches at successive UTF-16 start positions including overlaps. Overlapping occurrence ambiguity requires existing contextual resolution, never an arbitrary substitute.
citations.extraction_anchor: {turn_id,quote,occurrence}; exact matching, one-based overlapping occurrences, harness-computed UTF-16 offsets; no fuzzy normalization.

answer.form: {current:{status,rows},old:{status,records:[{predecessor_turn,status,rows}]},reason:{status,support}}; every key required; no extra properties. Rows contain scope, valid, route, approval, cap, citations. See answer.schema.json.
answer.explanation: Select a complete causal explanation from delivered quotations: every serial link, all necessary conjunctive language, or one independently sufficient complete alternative. No graph IDs. Bare deadlines alone earn no reason credit unless their passage is stated to cause expiry.
answer.negative_reason: not_stated requires empty support and means no stated cause, not merely unavailable evidence.

examples.en: Record elm said route = qeta. Correction: elm was never adopted; adopt record fern with route = voxi. The old assertion is erroneous; fern is adopted. By contrast, “reject the proposal fern” adopts no replacement.
examples.zh-Hant: elm 曾記載路線 qeta。更正：elm 從未採用；採用 fern，路線 voxi。elm 有誤，fern 已採用。「否決 fern 提案」則不採用替代決定。

examples.en: elm specifies route qeta, approval true, cap 72 requests/day. A partial cap-only update to 4 requests/hour inherits route and approval and yields cap 96 requests/day. A complete replacement supplying route voxi alone specifies neither approval nor cap.
examples.zh-Hant: elm 指定路線 qeta、需經核准、上限每日 72。僅部分更新上限為每小時 4，保留路線與核准，上限等於每日 96。完整替換若只供應路線 voxi，核准及上限皆為 not_specified。

examples.en: An update only for TW preserves JP and US. Through 2032-02-03 ends at 2032-02-03T16:00:00.000Z; its passage explicitly causes expiry, with no fallback.

examples.en: For body text “abababa”, quote “aba” starts at UTF-16 positions 0, 2 and 4. occurrence 2 names position 2; overlapping ambiguity is not repaired by switching occurrences. For current item 0 body: {intent:"current",item:0,unit:"body",source:null,quote:"aba",occurrence:2}. A receipt uses unit:"receipt",source:0 and only that delivered excerpt.
examples.zh-Hant: 本文 abababa 中 aba 從 UTF-16 位置 0、2、4 開始；occurrence 2 指位置 2。重疊歧義不以改換次數修補。receipt 必須指定 source:0 且只能引用已交付的該段節錄。

examples.en: The declared predicate alias dispatch 設定 equals dispatch configuration. NFKC maps full-width Ａ to A in scalar text. If delivered text is “A”, quote “Ａ” fails. If only “capacity fell” survived truncation, the omitted causal conclusion cannot be cited. A delivered sameAsBody may address that same body, never an absent receipt.
examples.zh-Hant: 派送設定與 dispatch configuration 依公開表對應。純量文字以 NFKC 將 Ａ 轉 A；若交付文字為 A，引用 Ａ 無效。若截斷後只剩「容量下降」，不能引用未交付的因果結論。sameAsBody 僅能指向實際交付的本文。

name_tokens.prefix_exclusion: A name must match the complete token: both adjacent characters must be outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]. demo7 inside demo70 or demo7_suffix is invalid.
name_tokens.anchoring: Own-name and reference quote equals the submitted name before normalization, in a source_turns current-batch turn, exact one-based overlapping occurrence. Roles are semantic assertions, never inferred from substring presence.
name_tokens.normalization: NFKC, collapse whitespace and trim; preserve case. No case folding, phonetics, punctuation deletion or undeclared aliases.
name_tokens.own_name: The newly introduced record, not the old record in correct record ...; null if absent.
name_tokens.predecessor_refs: Quote each referenced record once at its current-batch mention; never guess an earlier turn. The private gold-free registry supplies target event/source identities before arm fan-out.

extraction.orthogonal_fields: Correction is a change type, never a commitment. The old assertion was never adopted; we adopt its replacement means commitment adopted and change_type correction. A rejected proposal has commitment rejected and enacts no decision.
extraction.source_coverage: List every current-batch turn used by event, slot, own-name/reference and reason anchors in source_turns. Never put an unavailable prior turn there. Copy exact quotes/actual local occurrences; harness computes offsets.
extraction.causal_clauses: Copy every explicitly stated serial clause, conjunction and sufficiency qualification with its source association in reason_quotes independently of supplied slots; no invented graph/implicit edge. Deadline passage must explicitly cause expiry, not merely name a date.
extraction.admission: Closed-wire structural validation precedes event/domain admission. Invalid core excludes the event and all attached reasons; no enum coercion, defaults or manufactured context repair. Bad individual assignments/quotes remain independently excluded under A-4. This crosswalk is instruction/domain validation, not provider-enum restrictions turning event rejection into batch rejection.
extraction.context: Use anchored context payload only for independently source-stated non-slot context with valid core and its own exact text anchor. Do not emit an empty slots payload or duplicate every decision/reason into a context archive. Eligibility is unchanged.
extraction.slots: Supply only anchored route/Text, approval/Boolean, cap/Quantity. Null means unsupplied; never fill inherited values. Preserve explicit replacement qualifications, audience cells and source-claimed intervals; observed time is not automatically effective time. Complete/partial replacement must be stated, never guessed.
extraction.registry: Gold-free identity annotations only; no source-name snippets automatically added to factual/reason receipts. No slot values/history in the private registry, no registry in model input or memory. Collisions, invalid annotations, missing/duplicate/self/forward references stay unresolved before writes, with original policy eligibility. No retry using later batches or adoption/currentness/scope to pick a duplicate.

example_exclusions.policy: All worked-example worlds, names, routes, source texts, outputs and case-specific mappings are excluded from research/calibration authoring. Shared primitives such as Boolean false and canonical units are not banned. Reserve the demo name namespace; never use examples as sampled worlds.

reader.recovery: Partial refinement inherits unspecified fields from its identified predecessor without requiring an explicit keep sentence. Recover only values and relationships established by actual delivered evidence. Complete replacement clears selected predecessor fields. Missing delivery is not not_specified, false or zero.
reader.unresolved: An unresolved processing label does not negate explicit source facts. Use them only if sufficient under shared update meanings; never reconstruct missing predecessor content or assume unresolved-reference values are known.
reader.history: no_active_decision requires rows:[]; last-known expiry values belong only in requested expired history. Match exactly requested predecessor turns/statuses. Questions announce the complete shared vocabulary, never the case answer.
reader.selection: Select every necessary serial, conjunctive and sufficiency clause or one complete sufficient alternative associated with the focal change. No endpoint-only, unrelated, speculative, negated, earlier-change or blanket whole-context explanation. Missing delivered explanation is unavailable, not an automatic not_stated. Factual negative R remains support-not-applicable with no new negative witness.
reader.addresses: Use decoded actual delivered units; item is actual selected-intent array position, source is displayed receipt index. Exact occurrence is counted within that exact unit. Do not relocate addresses, change occurrences, strip punctuation, cite omitted text or retry. Legitimate delivered aliases and overlapping ambiguity retain existing rules. C/O citation diagnostics stay separate.
